raw: Agent Name: Local_Knowledge_Expert, Step Number: 5, Reason for Mistake: Fabricated verification and conclusions—claimed to have checked schedules and “contacted” a gym using a placeholder phone number (212-555-1234) without actual evidence or tool use, and relied on an unverified gym list within 200m—leading to the unsupported conclusion that no gyms have classes before 7am.
